---
name: State / UT research
about: Research one state or union territory (one issue per region)
title: "Research: <State or UT name>"
labels: ["research"]
---

**Region:** <!-- e.g. Tamil Nadu -->

Follow `AGENTS.md` section 3 (source priority, no unsourced claims, exclusion check).

- [ ] 1. Sub-regions and communities listed (incl. religion, from census)
- [ ] 2. Everyday dress, rural and urban, for all six groups
- [ ] 3. Festive and ceremonial dress for all six groups; 1-3 best representations per group with a reason
- [ ] 4. Accessories with meaning flags (marital / religious / honour / mourning / community) and `restricted` where needed
- [ ] 5. Grooming and hair
- [ ] 6. Look range (skin, hair, faces), per sub-region or community if different
- [ ] 7. Occasions (festivals + life events) with months, per community
- [ ] 8. Settings: rural / urban / home / work / religious / nature
- [ ] 9. Occupations and work clothes
- [ ] 10. Seasons
- [ ] 11. Avoid list (stereotypes, mix-ups with neighbouring regions)
- [ ] 12. Exclusion check for every community (protection, restricted contact, objections, sacred dress)
- [ ] 12b. Heritage check: royal/court dress, warrior or religious orders, sacred ritual forms, community-owned designs, each with a decision (`AGENTS.md` 2.11)
- [ ] 13. At least 4 sources, at least 2 government/institutional or museum/academic
- [ ] 14. Every community has its own entries; no community shown only as poor, rural or exotic
- [ ] 15. `uv run scripts/check_all.py` passes
- [ ] 16. Maintainer review recorded in `reviews`
- [ ] 17. (optional) Native review recorded
